title: Web Scraping & Automation Engineer | Python, Playwright, n8n | Next.js
description:
Need data extracted, processed, and turned into AI-ready pipelines? I ship Python web scraping + Claude-powered RAG over the result — clean CSV/JSON delivered, plus the LLM agent that queries it. 90 days, 6 plugins, 4-host fleet. Senior, on-time.

What I deliver:

• Web scraping at scale — Playwright + Selenium + custom HTTP clients. Anti-bot resilience via fingerprint matching, header rotation, and stateful session handling. CSV/JSON/Postgres output, paginated and de-duplicated.

• RAG pipelines on the scraped data — pgvector + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense rerank). Anthropic Claude or AWS Bedrock for inference. Span-citations back to source URL for audit trail.

• Claude agent loops — MCP tool servers, structured-output prompts, deterministic post-extraction validation. Production-grade, not slide-deck demos.

• Workflow automation — Chrome plugins, macOS automation, NixOS fleet (4 hosts). Scrape → process → notify → archive, all gated and observable.

Stack I work in daily:

Python 3.12 · TypeScript · Go · Rust · Playwright · Selenium · FastAPI · pgvector · PostgreSQL · AWS Bedrock + Lambda · Anthropic Claude · MCP · Docker · Terraform · NixOS · OpenTelemetry

Track record:

• 6 production Claude Code plugins shipped to a public GitHub org (claude-mac-chrome, wa, kokoro-speakd, claude-classroom-submit, fand, linkedin-chrome-copilot)
• 4-host NixOS flake-based fleet; 150+ PRs in the last 90 days
• Signed releases — SLSA L2 + Sigstore + dual-format SBOM (CycloneDX + SPDX) on every artifact
• Public commit history with supply-chain attestations verifiable via `gh attestation verify`

How to engage:

1. 30-min discovery call — I'll ask about target sites/data, output format, volume, timing. No proposal pressure.
2. Fixed-scope POC ($500-2K) for one site/dataset — proves the stack works before a bigger commit.
3. Hourly at $95/hr post-POC OR retainer ($4K / $9K / $18K monthly).

Best fit: teams that already tried "just call the API" and hit walls. Worst fit: anyone wanting black-box no-code or willing to skip post-extraction validation.

Available: more than 30 hrs/week, response under 60 minutes during business hours (US East / LATAM overlap).
